name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Air Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): summon an Air Elemental, as if by Conjure Elemental; it obeys you while you concentrate, up to an hour.

summary: Once a day, summon an Air Elemental that obeys you (Concentration, up to 1 hour).
text: While you are holding this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your commands. It lasts as long as you maintain Concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), up to 1 hour. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
